text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I rolled out the SLO-driven prefetch + token-budget batching canary to staging an hour ago. Seeing p95 regressions on some low-token chat routes, not the heavy routes. anyone else see this?
liam: saw the alert. p95 jumped ~55ms -> 110ms for /v1/generate-chat-small on dedicated canary. :thinking:
priya: interesting — my initial thought is prefetch thrash with KV cache warming: small prompts cause frequent tiny batches and prefetch floods the GPU, kernel selection flips to a slower path.
derek: i pulled a flamegraph on the canary run. most time at kernel-launch overhead + device-to-host memcpy stalls when prefetch concurrent > 2. bench-bot posted the profile:
bench-bot:```
Profile summary (canary):
- total tokens served: 1.2M
- median batch size: 3 requests
- p50 latency: 42ms
- p95 latency: 178ms (baseline 120ms)
- hot path: device memcpy (28%), kernel launch setup (22%), queue spin (15%)
```
liam: kernel autotuner is choosing the fused attention kernel sometimes for len<=64, but throughput loses out on microbatches. maybe the perf table assumptions don't hold for tiny batch sizes.
maya: exact — we assumed fused attention benefits at batch >=8, but microbatching + prefetch ends up with many batch sizes 1..4. need to make kernel selector aware of effective batch-size distribution.
priya: propose: make route-tier token_budget target fall back to no-prefetch for routes where expected median_batch_size < 6 and avg_prompt_len < 80. we can express as config:```
queue_policy:
  name: slo_token_budget_v2
  params:
    default_token_budget: 150
    route_overrides:
      - route: "/v1/generate-chat-small"
        tier: free
        token_budget: 40
        prefetch: disabled
      - route: "/v1/generate-chat"
        tier: pro
        token_budget: 250
        prefetch: enabled
```
derek: +1 but instead of fully disabling prefetch maybe cap concurrent prefetches per-worker to 1 and add jitter to prefetch start. that reduced memcpy stalls in my local.
maya: also we should add a kernel-selection hint: if expected_effective_batch_size < 6 then prefer 'non-fused' kernel for len<=128. config snippet idea:```
kernel_selector:
  heuristics:
    - if_effective_batch_lt: 6
      prefer: default_attention
    - else:
      prefer: fused_attention
```
liam: let's add a short A/B in staging: control = current canary, variant A = prefetch capped + kernel hint, variant B = prefetch off for small routes. run for 24h and compare p95 per-route. canary flag: rollout.slo_prefetch_v2.
priya: i'll add the rollout flag and the two policy variants to the config repo. also will add a telemetry tag so we can slice p95 by (route,tier,median_batch).
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: rollout.slo_prefetch_v2 -> staging (50% nodes) at 2026-05-03T14:10Z. monitor p95 / error-rate / oom.
maya: one more datapoint — kv cache prefetch size multiplier was 2x by default. lowering to 1.2x reduced device memory churn in sims. put that in the experiment for A.
derek: also watch kernel queue depth metric; it was spiking before regressions. we should add an alert if queue_depth > 12 for >30s.
liam: ok i'll own the canary analysis notebook, will run route-level bootstrap to estimate p95 delta and report back after 24h.
priya: thanks — i'll push the YAML and feature flag PR now. tagging @maya @derek for reviews. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. if regressions persist after A/B we'll revert and iterate on token_budget algorithm (maybe use RL-based shaping later). for now aim for conservative prefetch when median_batch < 6.
